meta.source: Official Python documentation references: core syntax, built-ins, and base types

references.title: int
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the int built-in.
references.syntax:
age = int("25")
number = int(12.7)

references.title: float
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the float built-in.
references.syntax:
price = float("19.95")
ratio = float(3)

references.title: bool
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the bool built-in.

references.title: str
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the str built-in.
references.syntax:
name = str(value)
text = "hello"

references.title: type
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the type built-in.

references.title: isinstance
references.summary: Official Python documentation for isinstance.
references.syntax:
if isinstance(value, (int, float)):
    print("number")

references.title: list

references.syntax:
items = [1, 2, 3]

references.title: while

references.title: break / continue
references.summary: Official Python tutorial for break and continue.

references.summary: Official Python documentation for lambda expressions.
references.syntax:

references.summary: Official Python tutorial for list comprehensions.

references.title: try / except
references.summary: Official Python tutorial for handling exceptions.

references.title: with
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the with statement.
references.syntax:
with open("data.txt", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    text = file.read()

references.title: open
references.summary: Official Python documentation for reading and writing files.
references.syntax:
with open("data.txt", "r", encoding="utf-8") as file:
    text = file.read()

references.title: filter
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the filter built-in.
references.syntax:
numbers = [1, 2, 3, 4]
even = list(filter(lambda x: x % 2 == 0, numbers))

references.title: map
references.summary: Official Python documentation for the map built-in.
references.syntax:
numbers = [1, 2, 3]
squares = list(map(lambda x: x ** 2, numbers))

references.title: sorted
references.summary: Official Python documentation for sorted.
references.syntax:
items_sorted = sorted(items)
rows_sorted = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row["score"], reverse=True)

references.title: enumerate
references.summary: Official Python documentation for enumerate.
references.syntax:
for index, value in enumerate(items, start=1):
    print(index, value)

references.title: zip
references.summary: Official Python documentation for zip.
references.syntax:
for name, score in zip(names, scores):
    print(name, score)
